book.name: 1 Corinthians
book.title: 1 CORINTHIANS PAUL AN FEF AINAUIN IGAYAM CORINTH YANGAN AURIS

content: Omi woitetem ato masono sekuteten baisigogo god auris on anikakafun—Dura bag ot tasagob ot engon on sagob tabo. Sagob emon on am yawas ebiyamai toum etaseseir, baise bobo gagamin bag on nuabo, ato nuaboai on ekalesia sabu eyoyonis segeg.
Orot iyafan enonosin on bobo isagob nono, baise on bobo engon ato ebinonoten on men isagoben on.
Baise orot iyafan God ibinuaboai on, God on ato orot ebibasitai eboai ebinoanai.
On mes omi masono ato baisigogo god auris wokuteten a wam auris wobikakafun: Ot tasagob baisigogo god on yabin ambin nin tafanamai a men God tani mes ab kaitamom wat.
Basit ato seyoyores sau god, nan safamai o tafanamai semama (on dura bag “god” sigaraba a “bada” sigaraba);

baise ot aurit on God Taman kaitamom wat, On tafanam engon ifourai a ot On noan on ari tamama; ato men iyafan tani ab Bada Iesu Keriso kaitamom wat, On emon on tafanam engon ifourai, ato On emama on ari tamama.

Baise atonio bobo aurin on men sabu engon tutufin sisagob on. Sabu fani asi kik ba imatar baisigogo god aurin on ra ra sifour simanam, on mes osi masono sam on, asi bainonot senonosin ato masono on baisigogo god aurin sikutetai nono, ato osi asi bainonot on esasam ato senonosin osi on ato masono emon iyames on men sigumidaris on.
Baise bayu on men inboet tanan God aurin taniufin on; ot bayu men tanam aurin on men iniyamet komasit tanmatar on a bayu tanam on men iniyamet obit bag tanmatar on.
Baise wonkaifarem tiwag, men om toum am gogoi yawas on unafour ato sabu iyabon asi bainonot samisamis on uniyames asi bainonot unikomasen sinafeu sinbokomas.

Orot tani an bainonot samisamin on initem om toum am sagobai nan baisigogo god an tafaror goa amonai umair masono yam on; om arimon am boboai on unkufaiwarai masono ato baisigogo god aurin wokuteten on inam.
On mes atonio taim tuam an bainonot samisamin, ato Keriso on aurin irarabob on, om am sagobai on uyamai ukomasai.
Om atonio boboai uniyamai taitaim tutuam auris unbobokomas a asi bainonot samisamis unbigawuden on, om Keriso aurin ebokomas.
On mes yau bayu aifan a’nin on nan abiyamai taiu tuau ebokomas on, yau men masono a’nan men, onai yau men gibui aniyamai inbokomas men.
